findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 405 requests to 104 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 9.8 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 5.3 MB (54%) came from third-party domains, 2.6 MB of it from services classified as tracking (217 requests).

53 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), appier.net (Appier, advertising), bidr.io (Beeswax, advertising).
149 cookies were set by third-party domains (203 cookies in total).
